translations.web: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
translations.bsb: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king.
translations.kjv: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
translations.asv: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of thy hand, O king.
